verses.sanskrit:
अजगरो यथा लोके शेते निष्क्रियतां गतः ।
एवमात्मनि संतुष्टो मुनिः शान्तिमवाप्नुयात् ॥
verses.translation: Just as a python lies in the world having attained inaction, so too a sage content in the Self attains supreme peace.

verses.sanskrit:
यत् किञ्चित् लभते भोज्यं स्वल्पं वा यदि वा बहु ।
तुष्टः प्राश्नाति तत्सर्वं शुभं वाप्यशुभं तथा ॥
verses.translation: Whatever food one obtains, whether little or much, whether good or bad — one should eat it with contentment, without complaint.

verses.sanskrit:
त्यजेद् आत्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
समो जनेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यो ज्ञानवैराग्यसंयुतः ॥
verses.translation: For the purification of the Self, one should renounce desire, anger, and possessiveness. Being equal towards all people, endowed with knowledge and detachment.
